items.name: SDot
items.description: A fast, differentiable library for semi-discrete optimal transport.
summary_lines: Computes semi-discrete Optimal Transport between discrete measures and continuous densities.
Includes power diagrams and distributions such as images, Gaussian mixtures, meshes and polytopes.
Supports NumPy, JAX, PyTorch and CuPy, with CPU and GPU backends.

materials.title: Examples
materials.description: Explore features and applications of semi-discrete optimal transport through the SDot examples gallery.
